title: Restore the mandatory optimistic Paper label in Reference Average Maker-GTD decisions
author: agent:/root

scope.goal: Restore the already-mandated optimistic TouchNoDepth Paper warning label in every newly persisted raw decision for the exact ETH Reference Average Maker-GTD family, without changing any signal or execution behavior.
inScope: Define one canonical exact label value: optimistic TouchNoDepth Paper; not Live-equivalent; may overstate fills.
Persist that exact label in both the root raw decision and the nested maker_gtd evidence for newly created orders of the exact 28 ETH neutral Reference Average Maker-GTD PaperOnly strategies.
Extend the focused Maker-GTD regression to verify both persisted label locations while retaining the existing v5 incomplete-window signal assertions and maker_gtd_paper_v2 execution assertions.
outOfScope: Changing Reference Average signal calculations, windows, thresholds, directions, selected outcomes, entry timing, stake sizing, order-book gates, risk gates, or diagnostics other than the mandatory label fields.
Changing Maker-GTD pricing, placement attempts, PostOnly/GTD semantics, expiration, fill inference, lifecycle, PaperOnly or Live flags, strategy IDs, strategy membership, or historical records.
Adding the optimistic label to any alias, clone, descendant, other Maker family, or non-exception strategy.
Deploying, restarting services, changing production configuration, or modifying production data.
scope.periodOrFilter: Only future raw decisions created by the exact 28 ETH neutral Reference Average Maker-GTD PaperOnly strategy variants; no historical rewrite.
scope.firstVerification: Compare the current Maker-GTD raw-decision builder and focused test with the closed exception contract and the last known implementation that persisted the mandatory label.

requirements.text: Every newly created raw decision for the exact ETH Reference Average Maker-GTD closed exception must carry the exact mandatory optimistic Paper label at the decision root and inside its maker_gtd evidence.
acceptanceCriteria: The exact label is defined once and equals optimistic TouchNoDepth Paper; not Live-equivalent; may overstate fills.
A newly placed exact-family Maker-GTD Paper order contains paper_model_label with that exact value at the root of RawDecisionJson.
The same order contains maker_gtd.paper_model_label with that exact value.

Both label fields are written only after MakerGtdPaperExecutionContract.IsApprovedCurrentStrategyVariant(variant) returns true; no altered predicate, alias, clone, descendant, or other strategy family inherits them.

verification.expected: The focused test passes and proves both exact mandatory label fields are persisted for the exact Maker-GTD order.

verification.expected: The exact-family contract tests pass for all 28 unique group-8223 IDs/codes and reject variants with altered closed-exception predicates.

requirements.text: Restoring the mandatory label must not change Maker-GTD signal, pricing, placement, fill, lifecycle, PaperOnly, or Live-disabled behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: The existing maker_gtd_paper_v2 contract version, maximum-resting price, Pending order status, Resting run status, PaperOnly flag, and Live-disabled behavior remain unchanged in focused tests.
The production diff is limited to the canonical label constant and two diagnostic JSON fields; no execution or signal branch is modified.
The complete Reference Average focused test subset passes after the label restoration.
